phases.title: Off-design, above design Mach (M 3.25)
phases.explanation: A Mach reflection forms at the cowl lip: the lip meets freestream at 33.8° of turning, close to θmax (35.6° at M 3.25), and the strong lip shock interacts with the ramp shocks. The tool models neither the cowl shock nor its reflection, so its above-design recovery is an upper bound.

cfd_overlay.recovery_station: before the terminal normal shock (oblique-only recovery)

points.note: Mach reflection at lip; tool value is an upper bound. M 3.5 was run qualitatively only (not plotted): recovery not quantified.
